hook_text: Survey only the learners on the bus and 'everyone takes the bus'. That's how samples lie.
clip_script: Asking only the learners who arrive in the school bus would be a poor sample, because every one of them travels by bus. The result would claim almost everyone takes the bus.
visual_style: A school bus unloads; a pie chart turns entirely bus-coloured; then names drawn from a hat produce a fair mixed chart.
pacing: Quick setup, wrong chart, fair fix.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to learn how to choose a fair sample.
